purpose: Fix six allies in battle and soften cyan selection glow.

prompts.battle:
Edit the FIRST image only. This is a targeted fidelity correction to the approved layout concept, do not redesign it. Images 2 and 3 are character visual references from the original game. Keep the first image's map, entire camera framing, UI placement, navy/gold panel materials and Korean labels unchanged.
Correct the allied party on the lower-left stone floor to EXACTLY SIX SEPARATE RECOGNIZABLE CHARACTERS with SIX clearly paired short teal HP bars: (1) Cless, blond spiky-haired red-headband silver-armored male swordsman with red cape; (2) Mint, blonde white/purple priestess and white hat; (3) Velvet, long black-haired woman in black/red torn clothing with blade; (4) Farah, green short-haired martial artist in bright orange pants and red gloves, NOT a hooded soldier; (5) Tear, long light-brown-haired woman in cream/brown robes holding blue-orb staff; (6) Jade, long brown-haired male in blue coat and glasses holding spear. Images 2/3 define their pixel sprite identities. All SIX must be distinct and visible, preserve miniature pixel sprites, not anime portraits on map. Arrange them across six neighboring tiles in the same lower-left starting cluster, with body/HP occlusion minimized by the overhead view. Do not duplicate a character, omit Jade/Tear, or substitute a green hooded enemy. The reference first image currently omits/scrambles some party members, fix this only.
Also fix Cless status HP 211/211 and MP 94/94 bars so BOTH have full fill matching the written maximum. Replace the little generic diamond ornaments along left panel separators with subtle engraved floral metal joins; remove the glowing chevron at the end of the selected Move row (keep illustrated boot and muted teal focus). Do not alter the other UI. Six portraits across top remain free-order party status, never a turn queue. No added text callouts or new gameplay mechanics. Final image remains 16:9 full-screen concept labelled "개선안 · 구현 전 시안".
prompts.formation: Edit this party UI concept with one targeted change: reduce the selected Cless card's neon cyan outline and outer glow to a soft restrained dark-teal fill/edge plus its existing antique gold ornate corner clasps. Reduce primary confirm button glow the same way. The result must have clear but mild focus, no bright cyan bloom. Preserve ALL other pixels as closely as possible: the exact six visible characters, all text, 3x2 grid, five deployment medals on Cless/Mint/Farah/Jade/Tear ONLY, Natalia unmarked not deployed, total six deployed with one on page two, portrait, stats, icons and new card layout. Preserve the navy/gold style. Do not remove the selected ornate clasps; only remove excessive neon glow. Keep large readable Korean labels and 16:9 layout.
